shanghai-2022.notes: All three copies are of the 2022 ICPC Asia-East Continent Final (Shanghai, 25 March 2023) or its Universal Cup Stage 11 mirror (8-9 April 2023); none names a Shanghai Regional. The same three URLs are also sources of aec-2022, and shanghai-2022 (cms 6160) carries the same date as aec-2022 (cms 5537); a human should decide whether shanghai-2022 is a separate event or the CMS's second record of the EC Final. Page counts (17, 17, 21) and the 13 problems were counted with pdfinfo/pdftotext.

shanghai-2023.notes: No copy names a Shanghai Regional: all are of the 2023 ICPC Asia East Continent Final (EC-Final 2023) or its Universal Cup Stage 23 mirror (17-18 February 2024). shanghai-2023 (cms 7701) has the same date as aec-2023 and the same icpcarchive.github.io EC-Final URLs; a human should decide whether shanghai-2023 is a separate event or a second CMS record of the EC Final. s1 is a crawl of about 150 Universal Cup dashboards of many stages, not a site of this contest. s4 is now a real dashboard (the earlier copy was a login form). Counts (25 and 57 pages, 13 problems) were taken with pdfinfo/pdftotext and the pages' problem tables.
